description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the MethodSourcer class, which generates method source code strings based on method signatures and attributes. It verifies the output of MethodSourcer for various method scenarios, including void methods with exceptions and methods returning parameterized types.

classes.name: MethodSourcerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating method source code generation by MethodSourcer.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes StringWriter and Output objects before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources after each test.

methods.name: testVoid
methods.description: Tests the source code output for a simple void method with no exceptions.

methods.name: testVoidThrow
methods.description: Tests the output for a void method that throws an exception.

methods.name: testReturnMap
methods.description: Verifies source code generation for a method returning a parameterized Map type.
